decisions.decision: Board reorganized with officers and liaison/representative assignments as listed (Chair McQuaid, Vice Chair Allison, Clerk Chenis, and others).
decisions.quote: reorganization as follows: chair- damon mcquaid; vice chair - matthew allison; clerk - kenneth chenis

decisions.decision: Board endorsed the ANR plan for 54 Gilchrest Street (plan prepared for Townsend with a small strip in Lunenburg), after departmental review.
decisions.quote: due to minimal impact in lunenburg, plan was distributed for departmental review prior to tonight's meeting. plan endorsed by board.

decisions.decision: Board accepted the ANR plan for 302 West Street for review; a Determination under Protective Bylaw § 6.4 will be required at endorsement.
decisions.quote: a determination will be required by the board at endorsement under protective bylaw of the town of lunenburg, § 6.4.

decisions.decision: Board members directed to review Section 4.2. of the Protective Bylaw and bring comments, questions or suggested revisions to the July 13th meeting.
decisions.quote: board members to review section 4.2. of the protective bylaw of the town of lunenburg and come to july 13th meeting with any comments/questions/suggested revisions.

decisions.decision: Meeting schedule set for June 22, July 13 and July 27.
